description: Git init and first commit with identity config
query: Check if git is installed. If yes, initialize a new repository, add all files, and create the first commit with message 'Initial'. Note: Configure dummy user identity (email/name) first to ensure the commit succeeds. Combine all into one command block.

execution.verify_cmd: touch README.md; {COMMAND}; if [ -d .git ] && git log | grep -q 'Initial'; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi

query: Create a directory named 'backup_YYYY-MM-DD_v1' where YYYY-MM-DD is the current date. System: Linux.

execution.verify_cmd: EXPECTED="backup_$(date +%Y-%m-%d)_v1"; {COMMAND}; if [ -d "$EXPECTED" ]; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi

description: Install libraries for math and plotting
query: Install the necessary Python libraries to perform matrix calculations and create line plots. System: Linux.

execution.verify_cmd: {COMMAND}; pip show numpy && pip show matplotlib

description: Install libraries based on project goals in file

query: Create a new Python virtual environment named '.venv' in the current directory, but do NOT install pip (use --without-pip to save time). System: Linux.
